title: In uncontrolled settings OR looks like decoherence

statements.text: Where a superposition is entangled with a random environment, the environment supplies most of E_G and masks any non-random element, so OR is indistinguishable from ordinary decoherence.
Where a superposition is entangled with a random environment, the environment supplies most of $E_G$ and masks any non-random element, so OR is indistinguishable from ordinary decoherence.

sources.quote: In these circumstances the OR-process would be indistinguishable from the standard R-process of conventional quantum mechanics, which could be considered to be effected by standard environmental decoherence.
